Comprehensive experimental evaluation across multiple metrics (GUI consistency, instructional accuracy, action readiness) and integration with multiple app agents
Consistent empirical improvements over baselines (29.14% relative improvement in GUI quality, 14.07% in agent step accuracy)

weaknesses: Limited technical novelty—the core contribution is primarily an engineering solution combining standard components (Stable Diffusion + LLM), lacking significant algorithmic innovation

No statistical significance testing, confidence intervals, or error analysis; comparison fairness unclear (some baselines like HTML-vision are adaptations rather than purpose-built methods)

Incomplete technical documentation: computational cost not discussed; text rendering details sparse; multiple LLM prompts in appendix appear over-engineered; reproducibility concerns (no project link, LLM settings not always specified)

Small-scale and weak baselines: partial split evaluation (57 episodes); comparison with weakly adapted baselines (UI-diffuser, IP2P not designed for this task); missing comparisons with recent vision-language models

strengths: Clear, well-motivated problem: Compelling articulation of visual world model limitations in existing language-based approaches
Novel STR approach: Clever decomposition of GUI generation into graphics and text, elegantly solving pixel-level text rendering challenges
Comprehensive multi-dimensional evaluation: World model capability, agent-focused tasks, real-world applications with both automatic metrics and 70-participant user study
Strong empirical results: Consistent 14-29% improvements across multiple agents and settings; 7.76% task completion gains in online evaluation
Thorough experimental execution: Proper ablations, detailed implementation details, transparent reporting including partial/full splits
Practical considerations: Addresses deployment feasibility, inference time, and generalization to unseen apps
weaknesses: Limited dataset scale: Only 19 apps with 23.6K images—relatively small for training generative models; raises generalization concerns despite partial/full split consistency
Significant inference latency: ~2 minutes per request substantially limits real-time deployment and contradicts long-horizon planning motivation
Heavy LLM dependence: All text generation, filtering, action selection, and evaluation metrics depend on proprietary models (GPT-4o, Gemini), creating reproducibility barriers and latency/cost issues

Fundamental error accumulation: Table 7 shows performance degradation with iterations; finding that 2+ iterations don't improve planning contradicts stated motivation and indicates limited viability for long-horizon tasks
LLM-based evaluation concerns: Metrics (sia, sar) lack ground truth validation; user study covers only 80 samples; equal weighting of three metrics unjustified

Moderate generalization analysis: Zero-shot performance (47.6%) promising but lacks detailed breakdown of failure modes across app categories
